full_query: How long does this years flu usually last?
sentences: The duration of influenza (flu) can vary depending on several factors, including the individual's age, overall health, and the specific strain of the virus
Generally, the flu typically lasts around 1-2 weeks, but it can range from 5-14 days
Symptoms can start to improve within 3-4 days after the onset of illness, but it may take up to 2 weeks for a person to fully recover
However, some people, especially older adults and young children, may experience prolonged illness or complications that can last longer

It's essential to note that antiviral medications, such as oseltamivir (Tamiflu) and zanamivir (Relenza), can help shorten the duration and severity of the flu when started within 48 hours of symptom onset
